# Night City Net Lore and Source Register

This file is an internal production reference. It is intentionally kept outside the published player-facing site.

## Content classifications

- **Canon anchor:** A corporation, game, district, technology, or historical condition established by an official Cyberpunk source.
- **Source-informed adaptation:** Original material written to fit an established organization, location, or 2045 condition.
- **Original campaign material:** Characters, headlines, cases, businesses, comments, forms, advertisements, and incidents created specifically for this project.

The presence of a canon anchor does not make every sentence on that page official lore. Most player-facing copy is original campaign writing built around source-informed constraints.

## Source library consulted during development

- Cyberpunk RED Core Rulebook and errata
- Night City 2045 and the Night City Atlas
- Night City Weather
- Black Chrome
- Corporation Report 2020
- Protect & Serve
- Firestorm: Stormfront and Firestorm: Shockwave
- Live & Direct
- Rockerboy

The source PDFs remain outside the published repository. This project should never distribute the books or reproduce substantial passages from them.

## Continuity rules

- Player-facing present day is 2045 unless a page clearly labels an older archival date.
- Do not use characters introduced substantially later in the timeline as active 2045 celebrities or public figures.
- Do not use real contemporary celebrities.
- Original characters should remain internally consistent in appearance, occupation, affiliations, and public history.
- Combat Zones and the Hot Zone do not receive ordinary municipal-law treatment or routine corporate deployment promises.
- Corporate sites should describe failure through eligibility, authorization, liability, bandwidth, or contract language rather than admitting institutional weakness directly.
- Government failures should feel procedural, underfunded, and fragmented rather than omnipotent.
- Public downloads should be small original handouts, not copied sourcebook pages.

## Review practice

When a new canon claim is added, record the source title and a short topic note here or in a private campaign notebook. When a detail is invented, keep it confidently in-world but do not present it outside the game as an official quotation or rule.
